allow: PowerShell($gradleDir = "$env:USERPROFILE\\.gradle\\caches"; if \(Test-Path $gradleDir\) { $size = \(Get-ChildItem $gradleDir -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum\).Sum; Write-Host "Gradle caches: $\([math]::Round\($size/1GB, 2\)\) GB" } else { Write-Host "Not found" })

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\\.gradle\\caches" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name, @{N='SizeGB';E={[math]::Round\(\(Get-ChildItem $_.FullName -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object Length -Sum\).Sum/1GB,2\)}})
